hunks.baseline: Circulating qi and regulating the breath was not solely about increasing internal energy.
hunks.sol: Circulating qi did more than increase internal energy.

hunks.baseline: Naturally removing the waste that accumulated inside the body and calming the mind were also among the many benefits of circulating qi.
And since circulating qi brought one into a state of supreme concentration, it went without saying that all five senses were heightened to their limits.
hunks.sol: It cleared away the waste that naturally built up in the body and calmed the mind. And in a state of such deep concentration, all five senses were heightened to their limits.

hunks.baseline: *What is this…?*
hunks.sol: *What’s that…?*

hunks.baseline: Thud. Thud. Thud.
hunks.sol: *Step. Step.*

hunks.baseline: Before long, I realized who the uninvited guest pacing outside the door was and brought my internal energy under control.
hunks.sol: I soon recognized the uninvited guest pacing outside the door and drew my internal energy back in.

hunks.baseline: Just as a System notification announcing the end of my qi circulation rang out, the doorknob behind me began to turn.
hunks.sol: The System notification announcing the end of my qi circulation had barely sounded when the doorknob turned behind me.

hunks.baseline: A strong scent wafted through the narrow gap as the door opened cautiously.
hunks.sol: A rich scent drifted through the gap as the door eased open. I let out a long breath, bringing everything to a close, and spoke.

hunks.baseline: After finishing everything with a deep exhale, I spoke.
“I thought I said no one was to come in until I came out on my own… Are you unable to understand human speech because you’re a monster? Or do you just have no intention of understanding it?”
hunks.sol: “I thought I told everyone to stay out until I came out on my own… Is it because you’re a monster that you can’t understand human speech? Or do you just not want to?”

hunks.baseline: The uninvited guest hesitated before clearing his throat. It was the Skeleton King.
hunks.sol: The uninvited guest hesitated, then cleared his throat. It was the Skeleton King.

hunks.baseline: “Yeah. Maybe because you’re already dead, but you don’t breathe.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. You don’t breathe. Probably because you’re already dead.”

hunks.baseline: “…That makes a strange amount of sense, but it’s still unpleasant.”
hunks.sol: “…That makes a strange amount of sense, but I don’t like it.”

hunks.baseline: “There’s no reason for me to go out of my way to make you happy.”
hunks.sol: “I’m not trying to make you happy.”

hunks.baseline: I pulled on the tracksuit I had carelessly taken off nearby and turned around. The Skeleton King stood there like a butler, holding a gleaming silver tray.

hunks.baseline: Normally, he would have been sulking hard by now, his pout stretching a good thirty feet.
hunks.sol: Normally, he would have been sulking by now, his lips sticking out a good five feet.

hunks.baseline: But today, the Skeleton King was different. He kept glancing at me nervously as he lowered the silver tray to the floor.
hunks.sol: But today was different. He kept stealing glances at me as he lowered the tray to the floor.

hunks.baseline: “But you have been fasting for more than three days.”
hunks.sol: “But you haven’t eaten in over three days.”

hunks.baseline: More than three days?
hunks.sol: Over three days?

hunks.baseline: Taken aback by his unexpected words, I looked around.

It was a room sealed off on all sides, without even a window. I had come in without my smartphone, and whether because of that or because I had not had the energy to care, I had completely lost track of time.
hunks.sol: I looked around. The room was sealed on all sides, without so much as a window. I had come in without my smartphone, and whether it was that or the fact that I’d had no mind to care, I’d lost track of time.

hunks.baseline: *Has it already been that long?*
hunks.sol: *Has it been that long already?*

hunks.baseline: Humans were strange creatures. They were even stranger when belated hunger struck the moment you realized how many days had passed.
hunks.sol: Humans were strange. The moment I realized how many days had passed, hunger caught up with me.

hunks.baseline: Thousands had died, and tens of thousands had been injured. I did not know what kind of lives they had led, but most of them must have been innocent people.
hunks.sol: Thousands had died. Tens of thousands had been injured. I didn’t know what kind of lives they’d led, but most of them must have done nothing wrong.

hunks.baseline: Those very people had suffered because of what I had done. They had died, been injured, and lost their precious families and friends.
hunks.sol: Those people had suffered because of what I’d done. They’d died, been hurt, lost family and friends they loved.

hunks.baseline: Until only a short while ago, the people who had raised me up as a hero had turned away one by one, and the arrows of condemnation had reached the people around me as well.
hunks.sol: People who had hailed me as a hero only a short while ago had begun turning against me, one by one. Their condemnation had reached the people around me, too.

hunks.baseline: *What exactly went wrong? And where did it begin?*
hunks.sol: *What went wrong? Where did it start?*

hunks.baseline: I had shut myself away in this room to find the answer to that question, which refused to leave my mind. Without eating or sleeping, I had spent each day circulating qi and lost in thought.
hunks.sol: I’d shut myself in this room to answer the question that wouldn’t leave my mind. I’d spent each day without food or sleep, circulating qi and turning it over in my thoughts.

hunks.baseline: And at last, I had found an answer.
hunks.sol: At last, I’d found an answer.

hunks.baseline: It was not an answer that could neatly resolve everything, but it was an insight that allowed me to forget it for a while.
hunks.sol: Not one that would put everything right. Just an insight that let me forget for a little while.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King froze as if he were buffering before answering.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King seemed to buffer for a moment before answering.

hunks.baseline: “Uh, yeah. It’s doenjang jjigae and braised short ribs.”
hunks.sol: “Oh. Yeah. Doenjang jjigae and braised short ribs.”

hunks.baseline: Even from the smell alone, I could tell who had made it.
I pictured my mother anxiously preparing meals for me over the past several days and lifted the lid covering the silver tray.
hunks.sol: I could tell who had made it just from the smell. Picturing my mother anxiously preparing meals for me these past few days, I lifted the lid from the tray.

hunks.baseline: I stared blankly at the food as steam rose from it. Then I scooped up a spoonful of doenjang jjigae, something I had not seen in a long time.
hunks.sol: Steam rose from the food. I gazed at it for a moment, then took a spoonful of the doenjang jjigae I hadn’t seen in so long.

hunks.baseline: The moment I put it in my mouth, I spat it right back out.
hunks.sol: The instant it touched my tongue, I spat it out.

hunks.baseline: I looked back and forth between the flustered Skeleton King and the doenjang jjigae before opening my mouth hesitantly.
hunks.sol: I looked from the flustered Skeleton King to the stew and back again.

hunks.baseline: A problem? There was one. A serious one.
hunks.sol: Was something wrong? Yes. Seriously wrong.

hunks.baseline: But instead of answering, a quiet laugh escaped me.
hunks.sol: But instead of answering, I let out a quiet laugh. I didn’t know why. I just did.

hunks.baseline: I did not know why. It just did.
“I’ll eat and then go.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll eat before I go.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ll just eat this and go. And I’ll take a shower, too.”
hunks.sol: “I said I’ll eat this, then go. I need a shower, too.”

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King blinked for a while, as though he had not understood me, then hurriedly nodded.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King blinked at me for a while, as if he hadn’t understood. Then he nodded hurriedly.

hunks.baseline: “Oh? Oh, understood. Then this body will…”
hunks.sol: “Oh? Oh, all right. Then this body will…”

hunks.baseline: He slowly closed the door and disappeared like a thief, and another inexplicable laugh escaped me.
hunks.sol: He eased the door shut and slipped away like a thief. Another inexplicable laugh escaped me.

hunks.baseline: I set down my spoon, picked up a piece of braised short rib, and took a large bite.
hunks.sol: I set down my spoon, picked up a piece of braised short rib, and took a big bite.

hunks.baseline: Fortunately, the braised short ribs had been made by my mother.
hunks.sol: Thankfully, my mother had made the ribs.

hunks.baseline: “There were vicious dogs going around biting people, so I beat them senseless. But this time, two mad dogs showed up.”
hunks.sol: “There were vicious dogs going around biting people, so I beat them senseless. Now two mad dogs have shown up.”

hunks.sol: Those were my first words to Team Leader Choi in days. His lips moved as though he had been about to say something, but he nodded instead.

hunks.baseline: “Mad dogs are nothing more than mad dogs. In the end, it is only a matter of timing and pretext. They would have bared their fangs at people sooner or later.”
hunks.sol: “Mad dogs are mad dogs. The timing and the excuse may change, but they would have bared their teeth at people sooner or later.”

hunks.baseline: “But I’m the one who gave them the opportunity to do it.”
hunks.sol: “But I’m the one who gave them the opportunity.”

hunks.baseline: “If you insist on blaming yourself, then say ‘we.’ This wasn’t something Jin Taekyung did alone.”
hunks.sol: “If you insist on blaming yourself, say *we*. You didn’t do it alone.”
